component.name: Momento
component.summary: Instant replay: save the last 15 seconds to 60 minutes

description.p: Momento is instant replay for Linux gaming, like the Create button on a PlayStation 5 or “record that” on an Xbox. It records your screen and sound in the background all the time, so you never have to remember to start recording. When something worth keeping happens, press Super+Shift+G, pick how far back to go, and the clip is saved to your Videos folder.

ul.li: Always keeps up to the last 60 minutes, including desktop sound and, optionally, your microphone
Eight clip lengths, from 15 seconds to a full hour
Clips are cut without re-encoding, so even an hour saves in seconds
Hardware H.264 encoding on AMD, Intel and NVIDIA graphics keeps the cost low
A slim clip bar that appears over fullscreen games on KDE Plasma, Hyprland and Sway
Works in desktop mode and in Steam Game Mode, on desktops, laptops and handhelds

description.p: The first time it starts, your desktop asks which screen Momento may record. The replay buffer is kept in your cache folder and its size is bounded by the length you choose.

screenshot.caption: The clip bar over a game, with the 5 minute length selected

ul.li: Continuous replay buffer of up to 60 minutes
Save 15 s to 60 min with Super+Shift+G or the command line
Hardware encoding through VA-API and NVENC
Clip bar with resolution, quality and sound settings
